description: Use this when the user needs an existing stock photo, illustration, background, wallpaper or texture — for a website, slide, blog post, app, video or design — rather than a newly generated image. Searches BudgetPixel's stock image library: AI-generated images, each reviewed before listing (no real people, logos or text), licensed CC BY 4.0 for commercial use. Costs 10 credits per search, charged even when nothing matches, so write one specific query rather than many vague ones. It never generates: if nothing fits, say so. LICENCE: wherever an image is used, include its credit line exactly as returned (the `attribution` text; `attribution_html` for web pages). Download from the returned URLs rather than hotlinking them in production.

limit.description: How many results to return (default 10, max 20). The price is the same for any limit.

offset.description: For the next page: the previous offset plus the number returned. Each page is a new 10-credit search.

orientation.description: Optional shape filter: landscape for headers and slides, portrait for phone wallpapers and stories.

query.description: What the image should show, in plain words — e.g. "misty pine forest at sunrise", "latte art on a wooden table", "abstract purple gradient background". Max 200 characters. Optional only when browsing a category.

sort.description: popular (default — best matches first when there is a query), newest, or top (highest rated).

type.description: Optional: photos only, or illustrations (including 3D and painted art) only.

name: search_stock_images
title: Search Stock Images
